data.one_liner: Detect and request disabling Android battery optimization with OEM auto-start shortcuts.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for Android that checks if battery optimization is enabled, prompts the user to disable it, and opens system settings. It also includes best-effort shortcuts for OEM-specific auto-start and background execution settings.
use_when: Your app requires reliable background execution on Android devices.
You need to check battery restriction status or prompt users to ignore battery optimizations.
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS or non-Android platforms where battery optimization controls do not apply.
Your app does not perform background work.
strengths: Provides typed optimization outcomes for clearer user flows.
Includes a diagnostics snapshot API for inspecting device manufacturer and power save state.
Covers multiple OEM background and auto-start settings paths.
weaknesses: OEM auto-start settings paths differ by device and may fail or return false depending on the hardware.
data.setup_notes: Declares REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS permission by default, which can be modified via manifest merge rules if needed.
